## The experience

What should someone be able to do, or what should Cairn handle better? A short fictional conversation is welcome.

## The idea

Describe a possible approach and how it serves the experience. An idea is a proposal until explicitly accepted.

## A small way to try it

What could we build or compare to learn whether it helps? Include a simpler alternative when useful.
